verdict.rationale: Logseq is open source and local-first: notes stay as local data, the source is available, users sync via their own GitHub repos, and graphs can be published as a static SPA you could host yourself. However, a community report says it cannot be self-hosted as a server-side web app with notes stored on your own server, and that this remains an open feature request; the official sync is a vendor service. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted server/web deployment, a self-hostable sync backend, and first-party self-hosting docs.
